// @thunderclap/engine/i18n: public API surface, generated by scripts/api-surface.mjs.
// Do not edit by hand. After an intended API change run `pnpm api:update` and commit this file.

## ArgNode  (type-only)
interface ArgNode {
    kind: 'arg';
    name: string;
}

## DurationOptions  (type-only)
interface DurationOptions {
    style?: 'digital' | 'long' | 'short' | 'narrow';
    hours?: 'auto' | 'always';
}

## FormatNode  (type-only)
interface FormatNode {
    kind: 'number' | 'date' | 'time';
    name: string;
    style: string | null;
}

## HashNode  (type-only)
interface HashNode {
    kind: 'hash';
}

## I18n  (type-only)
interface I18n {
    readonly locale: string;
    readonly locales: readonly string[];
    readonly direction: TextDirection;
    readonly ready: Promise<void>;
    t(key: string, args?: MessageArgs): string;
    has(key: string): boolean;
    setLocale(locale: string): Promise<void>;
    subscribe(fn: (i18n: I18n) => void): () => void;
    formatNumber(value: number, opts?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions): string;
    formatDate(value: Date | number, opts?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): string;
    formatDuration(ms: number, opts?: DurationOptions): string;
    formatList(items: readonly string[], opts?: Intl.ListFormatOptions): string;
}

## I18nDesc  (type-only)
interface I18nDesc {
    locale: string;
    fallback?: string | readonly string[];
    tables: Record<string, TableSource>;
    missing?: MissingPolicy;
    onMissing?: (key: string, locale: string) => void;
}

## IntlCache  (type-only)
interface IntlCache {
    plural(locale: string, ordinal: boolean): Intl.PluralRules;
    number(locale: string, style: string | null): Intl.NumberFormat;
    date(locale: string, kind: 'date' | 'time', style: string | null): Intl.DateTimeFormat;
}

## MessageArgValue  (type-only)
type MessageArgValue = string | number | boolean | Date | null | undefined;

## MessageArgs  (type-only)
type MessageArgs = Readonly<Record<string, MessageArgValue>>;

## MessageAst  (type-only)
type MessageAst = readonly MessageNode[];

## MessageNode  (type-only)
type MessageNode = string | ArgNode | FormatNode | HashNode | PluralNode | SelectNode;

## MessageSyntaxError
class MessageSyntaxError extends Error {
    readonly key: string;
    readonly column: number;
    constructor(key: string, column: number, detail: string);
}

## MissingPolicy  (type-only)
type MissingPolicy = 'key' | 'throw' | ((key: string, locale: string) => string);

## PluralNode  (type-only)
interface PluralNode {
    kind: 'plural';
    name: string;
    ordinal: boolean;
    offset: number;
    exact: ReadonlyMap<number, MessageAst>;
    categories: ReadonlyMap<string, MessageAst>;
    other: MessageAst;
}

## RTL_LANGUAGES
const RTL_LANGUAGES: ReadonlySet<string>;

## SelectNode  (type-only)
interface SelectNode {
    kind: 'select';
    name: string;
    cases: ReadonlyMap<string, MessageAst>;
    other: MessageAst;
}

## Table  (type-only)
type Table = {
    readonly [key: string]: string | Table;
};

## TableSource  (type-only)
type TableSource = Table | (() => Promise<Table | {
    default: Table;
}>);

## TextDirection  (type-only)
type TextDirection = 'ltr' | 'rtl';

## compileTable
function compileTable(table: Table, locale: string): Compiled;

## createI18n
function createI18n(desc: I18nDesc): I18n;

## createIntlCache
function createIntlCache(): IntlCache;

## directionOf
function directionOf(locale: string): TextDirection;

## formatMessage
function formatMessage(ast: MessageAst, args: MessageArgs | undefined, locale: string, intl: IntlCache): string;

## languageOf
function languageOf(locale: string): string;

## negotiateLocale
function negotiateLocale(available: readonly string[], requested?: readonly string[], fallback?: string): string;

## parseMessage
function parseMessage(source: string, key?: string): MessageAst;
